intro: FunPlay Systems designs and builds outdoor playground equipment for schools, housing societies, parks and resorts in Chennai. Everything is made at our factory in Vasai, near Mumbai, where we have been manufacturing play equipment since 2002. We send the finished equipment to Chennai by road and install it on site with our own team or a dealer near you.

Most Chennai enquiries we get fall into three groups. Builders need a play area for a new apartment project, schools need equipment that takes heavy daily use, and public parks stay busy from early morning to late evening. We help with all three, from picking the equipment to planning the layout and the safe play area around it.

sections.h: Choosing playground equipment for Chennai's weather
sections.html:
Chennai is hot and humid for most of the year, and sites near the coast get salt in the air. That combination is hard on bare metal. Galvanised steel posts and roto-moulded plastic parts hold up far better, because plastic does not rust and the zinc coating protects the steel. If your slides or decks face the afternoon sun, plan some shade over them so the surfaces stay comfortable to touch.

The northeast monsoon, from October to December, brings most of the city's rain, and water collects quickly on flat ground. We suggest a slightly raised, well-drained base with rubber flooring or another impact-absorbing surface under the equipment. We supply rubber flooring along with the play equipment if you need it.

• Builders and housing societies along OMR, ECR, GST Road and in the western suburbs who need a play area ready before handover.
  • CBSE, ICSE and state board schools that want equipment for several age groups on one ground.
  • Municipal and corporate parks, including open-air gyms for adults and senior citizens.
  • Resorts, clubs and hotels, especially along the East Coast Road, that want a feature piece for families.

Each of these buyers has different needs. A builder wants a compact layout that looks good in brochures, a school wants pieces for several age groups, and a park needs equipment that can take crowds every evening.

1. Share the size of your site, the age group of the children and a few photos. We suggest equipment and send a layout drawing with the safe play area marked.
  2. Once you approve the layout and the quote, we manufacture the equipment at our Vasai factory.
  3. We pack it and dispatch it to Chennai by road.
  4. Our installation team or a local dealer installs it, using the self-standing or grouting method that suits your ground.

Through each step you deal with one contact person at FunPlay, who keeps you updated on manufacturing and dispatch.

For apartment play areas, a CoreCraft multi play system packs slides, climbers and decks into a compact footprint. Schools often choose a Funplay Originals design such as Ulta Ghar or Card Pyramid, which are built for groups of children to play together. Larger sites can look at the NexLev series. For adults, see our outdoor gym equipment in Chennai. If you are not sure where to start, send us photos of the site and we will shortlist three or four options that fit your space and budget.

faq.q: Do you deliver and install playground equipment in Chennai?
faq.a: Yes. We manufacture the equipment at our factory in Vasai, send it to Chennai by road and install it through our own team or a local dealer.

faq.q: Which materials last longest in Chennai's humid, coastal weather?
faq.a: Galvanised steel and roto-moulded plastic hold up best because they do not rust. For sites close to the sea, rinse the equipment from time to time and follow the maintenance steps we share at handover.

faq.q: What warranty do you give on playground equipment?
faq.a: Three years on galvanised pipes, roto-moulded parts, composite laminates and play rope, and one year on springs, bearings and spare parts. It covers manufacturing defects when the equipment is installed and maintained as per our instructions.

faq.q: Can you plan a playground for a small society or school ground?
faq.a: Yes. Send us the length and width of the space and the age group of the children. We will suggest equipment that fits and mark the safe play area on a layout drawing.

intro: FunPlay Systems supplies outdoor playground equipment to schools, housing societies and parks in Kolhapur. We make every piece at our factory in Vasai, about 330 km away, and bring it to Kolhapur by road. Our installation team or a local dealer then sets it up on your site, on a self-standing base or grouted into the ground.

Kolhapur buyers often ask for equipment that can take daily use by large groups. That could be a school compound, a society garden in one of the newer residential areas or a public garden run by the municipal corporation. Tell us the size of the space and the age group of the children, and we will send a layout drawing with the safe play area marked before you decide. Most projects start with a few photos of the site and a short phone call.

sections.html:
Kolhapur gets heavy rain from June to September, and flat ground near the Panchganga river can stay wet for days. Raise the play area slightly, give it a drainage slope and lay rubber flooring under slides and swings so children do not play on mud or hard stone. Galvanised steel posts and roto-moulded plastic parts handle the wet months well, since plastic does not rust and the zinc coating protects the steel.

If you also want fitness equipment for adults, see our outdoor gym equipment in Kolhapur.

faq.q: Do you install playground equipment in Kolhapur?
faq.a: Yes. We send the equipment from our Vasai factory by road and install it with our own team or a dealer close to Kolhapur.

faq.q: What is the best surface under playground equipment in a rainy area?
faq.a: Rubber flooring on a slightly raised, well-drained base. It cushions falls and dries faster than soil or grass after heavy rain.

faq.q: Can you suggest equipment for a small society garden?
faq.a: Yes. Share the length and width of the garden and the age group. We will suggest pieces that fit and mark the safe play area on a layout drawing.

intro: FunPlay Systems supplies outdoor gym equipment to municipal gardens, housing societies, schools and walking tracks in Kolhapur. Our Fun Fitness range is made at our factory in Vasai, about 330 km away. We deliver it to Kolhapur by road and install it with our own team or a local dealer, grouted or self-standing depending on your ground.

An open-air gym works well in Kolhapur's gardens and lake-side walking areas, where people already come out early in the morning. Our machines use the person's own body weight, so they suit beginners and senior citizens as much as regular walkers, and they need no electricity or adjustment. A society can start with three or four machines along its walking path and add more later, since each station stands on its own base.

sections.h: Choosing outdoor fitness equipment for a Kolhapur site
sections.html:
Popular choices for a Kolhapur garden are the Fun Walker Double, the Chest Press and the Tai Chi wheel. Most of the city's rain falls between June and September, so the equipment stays outdoors through months of wet weather. The frames are galvanised pipe with a 3-year warranty, and moving parts such as bearings carry 1 year. Plan a firm, level base, grouted or self-standing, and leave clear space around swinging machines like the pendulum.

For a society that also needs a play area for children, see our playground equipment in Kolhapur.

faq.q: Which outdoor gym machines suit senior citizens?
faq.a: Low-impact machines such as the Fun Walker, Tai Chi and seated twisters. They use the person's own body weight and need no adjustment.

faq.q: Do you install open gym equipment in Kolhapur?
faq.a: Yes. We deliver from Vasai by road and install the machines with our own team or a local dealer, grouted or self-standing depending on your ground.

faq.q: How much space does an outdoor gym need?
faq.a: It depends on the number of machines. Send us the size of the area and we will suggest a layout with enough clear space around each station.

/funplay-originals/nature-sparsh/ulta-gh.description: Ulta Ghar is an upside-down house for children aged 3 to 8, built around a drop climber that surprises children the first time they find it. A tall tower with a green tube slide stands beside the tilted house, so one group can climb while another slides down. Up to 15 children can play at once within a safe play area of 17'11" x 16'8". Play on Ulta Ghar involves sliding and climbing, and it builds coordination, cooperative play, creativity and confidence with height. It belongs to our Nature Sparsh collection, comes in Forest Green, and carries a 3-year warranty on galvanised pipes, roto-moulded parts, composite laminates and play rope. Ask us for a layout drawing and a quote for your school, society or park.
/funplay-originals/nature-sparsh/ulta-gh.spec_paragraph: Ulta Ghar is built from galvanised pipes, roto-moulded parts and composite laminates, with a play rope net on the drop climber. It can be installed self-standing or grouted into the ground. Keep the full safe play area of 17'11" x 16'8" clear of benches and trees, and inspect the slide and net as part of your regular maintenance.
flags: Website product area 13'5" x 11'8" differs from the Originals catalogue (21'2" x 19'7"). Confirm with FunPlay.

/corecraft/individual-equipment/swing/cu.description: The Curve Post Swing is a two-seat swing set with curved teal posts and bright yellow seats, made for children aged 6 to 12. Two children can swing at the same time, and the curved frame gives it a softer look than a straight A-frame in a school or society garden. It needs a safe play area of about 11'1" x 13'3". It comes in Horizon Teal and carries a 3-year warranty on the galvanised pipes and a 1-year warranty on bearings and spare parts. Send us your site size and we will show you where it fits on a layout drawing.
/corecraft/individual-equipment/swing/cu.spec_paragraph: The frame is galvanised pipe, so it handles rain and humidity without rusting through. It can be installed self-standing or grouted, depending on your ground. Keep the swing zone free of benches and walkways, lay an impact-absorbing surface such as rubber flooring under the seats, and check the chains and bearings during routine maintenance.
